p: Portrait 3:4 game card illustration: a lady's hand gently closing a painted round silk fan and lowering it, her pink sleeve turning away from a half-open lacquered door toward a quiet inner chamber, the moment of letting a matter go. One clear centred focal subject, softly blurred palace background, readable at thumbnail size. Gufeng watercolour court illustration like the reference: soft ink lines, delicate washes, warm vermilion, gold, jade and soft pink, gentle light, rich luxurious detail. Show as few people as possible: only hands, forearms and wide Han/Ming sleeves, or a corner of a robe hem; NO faces, no heads, no full figures. Hands graceful and anatomically correct with five fingers, no fused or extra fingers. Men's sleeves never pink or purple; imperial yellow appears ONLY when the scene names the Emperor's yellow sleeve; otherwise ladies' sleeves are pink, jade green, red, ivory or blue, never yellow or gold-yellow. No skulls, no blood. No text, letters, Chinese characters, seals, border or signature; papers and books are blank or show only abstract lines.
